---
title: "Phase 2. Design"
description: "Choose the method, and turn the assurance level into a plan with time in the schedule."
---

You choose how the question gets answered, and turn the level agreed in Phase 1 into a plan
somebody will actually carry out.

## What you do

1. **Choose the method**, and place your work among the eight types of analytical model if it is
   a model. [The list is in after you have your level](../07-deciding-your-assurance-level/after-you-have-your-level.qmd#the-eight-types-of-analytical-model).
2. **Write the design and plan**, and share it with everyone involved.
   It covers the data, the method, how uncertainty will be identified and communicated, the
   assumptions and known limitations, ethics and information governance, the outputs, the
   timescales and resources, and the assurance activities.
3. **Turn the level into an assurance plan.** Set out the verification and validation the level
   asks for, and **put time for it in the schedule**. What each level
   asks for is in [deciding your assurance level](../07-deciding-your-assurance-level/index.qmd).
4. **Name your critical friend now**, before the work starts. They review the plan, confirm they
   can do the assurance it asks for, and put their own time in the schedule.
5. **Get the design approved** by your commissioner before work proceeds.
   Where time or resource constrain the approach, your commissioner needs to understand the risks
   that follow.

## Your design should

- **be repeatable**, producing the same results from the same inputs if somebody else runs it
- consider uncertainty, and say how it will be communicated
- consider whether the data sources are fit to answer the question
- be documented

## What you leave behind

- The design and plan, shared with everyone involved.
- The assurance plan, with time in the schedule for it and for your critical friend.
- Your critical friend's name against the work.
- Your commissioner's approval of the design.

## Ready for Phase 3 when

- The design is approved.
- The assurance plan has time in the schedule, including your reviewer's own time.
- Your critical friend has confirmed they can do the assurance the plan asks for.

## Who does what in this phase

| Role | In Phase 2 |
|---|---|
| **Analyst** | Choose the method. Plan the verification and validation the level asks for. Name your critical friend |
| **Critical friend** | Review the plan. Confirm the assurance planned is at the right level. Put your own time in the schedule |
| **Commissioner** | Approve the design. Make sure there is time and resource for the assurance the level requires |
| **Analysis Senior Responsible Officer** | Business Critical work only. Confirm design governance has been followed before the analysis starts |
